verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical, and both share the same flaws. The orange-tinted backdrop that defined the brand is gone, leaving a dark purple photo with a mismatched orange block in the middle. The white frame shrinks to a meaningless fragment that collides with the 'n' of 'Pygmalion'. The fast-forward icon grows into a huge focal point that competes with the title. 'Music and lyrics by Leland Carroll' sits jammed against the top edge, and 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents' wraps into a cramped five-line column.
